name: gradient-ascent
description: Local-first cycling coaching, local activity and recovery imports, optional Ride with GPS sync through its official ride CLI, and dashboards for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Local imports, coaching, and optional Ride with GPS sync.
interface.longDescription: Gradient Ascent packages a local-first cycling workflow: goals, plans, optional Ride with GPS sync through the actual official ride CLI, official Strava and Garmin account archives, local FIT/TCX/GPX files, Apple Health exports, a Training Center, and persistent coaching advice. The vendor CLI owns sign-in and tokens; this independent integration does not imply vendor endorsement.
defaultPrompt: Use $gradient-ascent to set up coaching in this workspace.
Use $coach-setup-plan to import my training calendar and event plan.
Use $coach-setup-activities to connect optional Ride with GPS through its official ride CLI or import my Strava archive and local ride files.
Use $coach-setup-recovery to import recovery and health exports.
Use $coach-setup-status to tell me what Gradient Ascent has configured and what matters next.
Use $coach-note to save this ride insight.
